title: Cover OpenCode terminal glyph repertoire
description: Add all non-CJK terminal UI glyphs currently emitted by OpenCode, retain and validate the pending heavy vertical glyph, add a reusable OpenCode-to-cmap audit utility, update documentation/version/counts, and run build/coverage checks.
acceptance_criteria: Claudaco contains all 46 audited OpenCode UI codepoints with 1229-unit advances; the audit reports no practical UI gaps; documentation and metadata counts are accurate; CI checks pass.
notes: Implemented 46 OpenCode UI glyphs plus retained U+2503, version 1.202, source-to-cmap audit, source-font-independent builder tests, OTS validation, and documented 565/552 metadata totals.
close_reason: Implemented and verified all acceptance criteria

title: Document glyph README updates
description: Add a repository agent rule requiring README updates whenever glyph coverage changes, then commit and push the glyph and documentation changes.
close_reason: Added the AGENTS.md rule requiring README coverage and metadata updates for glyph changes; validation passed.

title: Add requested whitespace glyphs
description: Add the Unicode whitespace glyphs supplied by the user to Claudaco, with regression coverage and regenerated font output.
close_reason: Added U+2003 EM SPACE as an outline-free fixed-cell glyph, bumped release identity to 1.203, regenerated the local font, and verified tests and font metrics.

title: Default to versioned font families
description: Make the patcher derive a versioned family and output filename by default so Windows installs each release independently, while preserving explicit family/output overrides; update README metadata and workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Default 1.202 build produces Claudaco-1.202-Regular.ttf with family Claudaco 1.202 and unique PostScript metadata; explicit overrides still work; docs and tests reflect the default.
notes: Default builds now derive family Claudaco VERSION and filename Claudaco-VERSION-Regular.ttf; explicit overrides remain supported. Added regression tests and updated primary metadata, build, audit, Windows install, and cache guidance.
close_reason: Versioned family and filename defaults implemented, tested, and documented

title: Document versioned Windows font install
description: Generate a uniquely named Claudaco 1.202 family and document how to bypass an undeletable older Windows font-family registration.
acceptance_criteria: A generated TTF has unique family, full, and PostScript names; README documents installation and cleanup options.
notes: Generated Claudaco-1.202-Regular.ttf with family Claudaco 1.202, full name Claudaco 1.202 Regular, and PostScript name Claudaco1202-Regular; OTS and OpenCode coverage checks pass.
close_reason: Versioned-family Windows workaround generated, verified, and documented
